description.value: Island Afrikan Supermarket has been serving Victoria since 2000, offering African groceries, beauty products, fashion, and accessories. As an independent specialty grocer on Quadra Street, it has built relationships with vendors to source quality African food products. A touring cyclist passing through Victoria would find it a distinctive stop for provisions not available at mainstream supermarkets.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands at 53m; stands at 53m; rack at 100m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business name, phone number, and provides a street address not present in OSM. The store sells African groceries, fashion, beauty products, and accessories, confirming it is a functioning specialty grocery. No mentions of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, hot food, ice, or any cyclist-specific amenities appear in either the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Website copy contains repeated references to 'Indian Grocery Store' in template-style text despite this being an African grocery — appears to be uncustomized website template boilerplate, not a factual error about the business.
OSM opening hours tag does not fully match the hours shown on the website; website hours should be considered more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, long-running specialty grocery store (est. 2000) in Victoria that a touring cyclist could use for food resupply; qualifies under the Groceries category.

wow_evidence: serving Victoria since 2000, offering African groceries, beauty products, fashion, and accessories
